title.zh: 各向异性自由边界 Picard 平衡

summary: Run a bounded Picard feedback of explicit anisotropic pressure, current and Green field; optional wall flux and its magnetic-field derivative update together, and all feedback-state unrelaxed residuals and parallel-force compatibility determine convergence.

capability: Run a bounded Picard feedback of anisotropic pressure, current and Green fields with an optional ideal-conductor wall correction.
operation: bounded axisymmetric gyrotropic-pressure Picard composition with optional linear wall correction
R-Z grid, vacuum state, Green matrices and pressure closure -> terminal equilibrium state and convergence diagnostics
discovery.model: Axisymmetric gyrotropic-pressure Picard composition with caller-owned pressure closure and optional linear ideal-conductor wall correction.
discovery.geometry: Finite, strictly increasing, nonnegative-R rectilinear tensor grid with at least three nodes per axis; nonuniform axes are supported and fields are indexed [Z,R].
discovery.boundary: Wall flux corrections carry their discrete poloidal-field derivative; caller matrices must describe compatible boundary sampling, and the operator does not validate physical conductor geometry or eliminate a truncated-SVD residual.

identity.relation: vacuum flux and field, dense cell-current Green responses and caller pressure closure to a bounded anisotropic R-Z equilibrium state
identity.direction: R-Z grid, vacuum state, Green matrices, pressure closure and controls -> final flux/field/pressure/current state and iteration diagnostics
identity.definition: Recompute the deterministic pressure closure and toroidal current on the current psi, BR and BZ; integrate current with nodal trapezoidal weights or explicit cell boundaries, mix the old current by relax, and project the Green field. When paired field Green matrices are absent, derive the field from the newly added plasma flux. The wall branch adds both wall flux and its discrete magnetic-field derivative. Before stopping, construct the unrelaxed target from the current pressure/current and require psi, BR, BZ and current all to close. The returned state recomputes the closure, current and parallel-force compatibility; maxiter=0 performs no update and does not claim convergence.
identity.model: axisymmetric gyrotropic-pressure Picard composition with caller-owned N4 pressure closure and optional linear ideal-conductor wall correction
identity.geometry: Finite, strictly increasing, nonnegative-R rectilinear tensor grid with at least three nodes per axis; nonuniform axes are supported.
identity.coordinates: fields indexed [Z,R]; Green source and field axes use C-order flattened grid points
identity.boundary: Wall flux corrections carry their same discrete poloidal-field derivative. Caller matrices must describe compatible boundary sampling and response; the operator does not validate the physical conductor geometry or eliminate a truncated-SVD residual.
assumptions: The pressure_closure callback returns scientifically justified nonnegative co-located pressure arrays and optional density/temperature arrays for each state, interpreting psi as R A_phi in Wb/rad.
All flux and field Green matrices share the declared current basis and appropriate Wb/rad/A or T/A units.
No supplied pressure-closure parameter is interpreted by the graph except inserting B0 when absent; the caller owns its physical model.

Default composite-trapezoid weights integrate exactly over the supplied node-domain rectangle; boundary nodes have half-interval weights. Explicit cell_edges=(radial_edges,axial_edges), each with center_count+1 monotone finite entries enclosing its centers, instead define cell-center areas. No 2*pi*R factor multiplies toroidal filament current.

pressure_closure is a deterministic scientific relation for a given {psi,B,params}; it does not modify input arrays or depend on the call count, and the graph re-evaluates it at stopping and at the terminal state. B>=minimum_field is required before every closure and current evaluation.

inputs.name: r_grid
inputs.description: Cylindrical radius tensor grid.
inputs.constraints: At least three samples per axis; strictly increasing, strictly monotone tensor axis; same shape as z_grid.

inputs.name: z_grid
inputs.description: Axial coordinate tensor grid.
inputs.constraints: Same shape as r_grid; strictly increasing, strictly monotone axial axis.

inputs.name: psi_vac
inputs.description: Vacuum/external psi=R A_phi and initial Picard flux state.
inputs.constraints: Exact grid shape; validated by the feedback dependency during iteration or the zero-step terminal branch.

inputs.name: br_vac
inputs.description: Vacuum radial poloidal field and initial BR.
inputs.constraints: Exact grid shape; field-magnitude dependency validates finiteness before closure.

inputs.name: bz_vac
inputs.description: Vacuum axial poloidal field and initial BZ.
inputs.constraints: Exact grid shape and co-located with br_vac.

inputs.name: g_psi
inputs.description: Dense source-cell-current to psi=R A_phi Green matrix.
inputs.constraints: Exact square grid-point size, with C-order source columns and field rows.

inputs.name: g_br
inputs.description: Optional source-current to radial-field Green matrix.
inputs.constraints: Must be supplied together with g_bz; when both are omitted, derive the BR increment from -(∂psi/∂Z)/R of the newly added plasma psi, then add br_vac and the optional wall increment.

inputs.name: g_bz
inputs.description: Optional source-current to axial-field Green matrix.
inputs.constraints: Must be supplied together with g_br; when both are omitted, derive the BZ increment from (∂psi/∂R)/R of the newly added plasma psi (regular limit on the axis), then add bz_vac and the optional wall increment.

inputs.name: params
inputs.description: Caller-owned pressure-closure parameter mapping.
inputs.constraints: Shallow-copied before use; if B0 is absent, the graph inserts positive b0 or the initial field-magnitude median. Other keys are passed through without physical validation by this graph.

inputs.name: pressure_closure
inputs.description: Caller-provided pressure closure evaluated at current state.
inputs.units: psi Wb/rad, B T; pressure output Pa
inputs.constraints: Returns p_parallel, p_perp, density and electron_temperature; pressures must be finite nonnegative exact-grid arrays; latter two may be None or finite nonnegative exact-grid arrays. The relation for a given state must be deterministic and must not rewrite inputs, and multiple evaluations are allowed; a field below minimum_field is rejected before the callback.

inputs.name: tol
inputs.description: Upper bound on the unrelaxed relative residual of every feedback state.
inputs.constraints: Finite strictly positive; compare max(flux_fixed_point_residual,field_fixed_point_residual,current_fixed_point_residual), and do not substitute the relaxed flux step.

inputs.name: maxiter
inputs.description: Maximum number of Picard updates.
inputs.constraints: Nonnegative; zero skips the update loop but still runs terminal closure/current evaluation.

inputs.name: relax
inputs.description: Retention weight of previous relaxed cell currents.
inputs.constraints: 0 <= relax <= 1; this is current-state, not flux-state, relaxation.

inputs.name: b0
inputs.description: Positive reference field inserted into params.B0 only if that key is absent.
inputs.constraints: When needed, None uses the median initial field magnitude; an explicit value must be positive. An existing params.B0 is not replaced.

inputs.name: plasma_mask
inputs.description: Active-cell selector for feedback and terminal current.
inputs.constraints: Exact grid shape and bool dtype when supplied; False cells are zeroed for feedback and terminal current.

inputs.name: boundary_correction
inputs.description: Optional ideal-conductor wall-flux correction configuration.
inputs.constraints: When supplied, requires dimensionless boundary_sample_matrix [N_b,N_f] and Wb/rad/A green_boundary_to_boundary [N_b,N_w] and green_boundary_to_field [N_f,N_w]; optional rcond defaults to 1e-10. Matrix validation belongs to the wall Operator.

inputs.name: cell_edges
inputs.description: Default composite-trapezoid weights integrate exactly over the supplied node-domain rectangle; boundary nodes have half-interval weights. Explicit cell_edges=(radial_edges,axial_edges), each with center_count+1 monotone finite entries enclosing its centers, instead define cell-center areas. No 2*pi*R factor multiplies toroidal filament current.
inputs.dtype: pair of finite arrays or None
inputs.constraints: Default composite-trapezoid weights integrate exactly over the supplied node-domain rectangle; boundary nodes have half-interval weights. Explicit cell_edges=(radial_edges,axial_edges), each with center_count+1 monotone finite entries enclosing its centers, instead define cell-center areas. No 2*pi*R factor multiplies toroidal filament current.

inputs.name: compatibility_tol
inputs.description: Maximum resolved parallel-force fraction.
inputs.constraints: Maximum resolved parallel-force fraction.

inputs.name: minimum_field
inputs.description: Positive terminal field floor in T.
inputs.constraints: Finite strictly positive; require all B>=minimum_field before every pressure-closure/current evaluation, including the initial state, intermediate feedback states and the returned state.

inputs.name: strict_compatibility
inputs.description: Raise on incompatible parallel pressure force; false retains explicit failed compatibility.
inputs.constraints: Raise on incompatible parallel pressure force; false retains explicit failed compatibility.

outputs.name: psi
outputs.description: Last wall-corrected or directly projected psi=R A_phi state.
outputs.constraints: At maxiter=0 equals psi_vac after terminal evaluation; optional wall correction changes psi and adds its consistent discrete magnetic-field increment.

outputs.name: BR
outputs.description: Last radial field state including plasma and optional wall-flux increments.
outputs.constraints: The supplied br_vac plus the g_br plasma response when field Green matrices are supplied, or the discrete radial field from the plasma flux increment otherwise; a completed wall correction adds its discrete radial field increment.

outputs.name: BZ
outputs.description: Last axial field state including plasma and optional wall-flux increments.
outputs.constraints: The supplied bz_vac plus the g_bz plasma response when field Green matrices are supplied, or the discrete axial field from the plasma flux increment otherwise; a completed wall correction adds its discrete axial field increment.

outputs.name: B
outputs.description: Terminal poloidal magnitude from returned BR/BZ.
outputs.constraints: Reevaluated from the returned BR/BZ after bounded iteration, including the discrete wall-flux field increment when present. Coherence of the supplied vacuum and Green responses remains a caller precondition.

outputs.name: profiles
outputs.description: Terminal pressure closure fields.
outputs.units: p_parallel/p_perp Pa; density m^-3 or caller units; electron_temperature caller units
outputs.constraints: Contains exactly p_parallel, p_perp, density and electron_temperature from the terminal callback, after array validation.

outputs.name: j_phi
outputs.description: Terminal toroidal current density after optional mask.
outputs.constraints: Reevaluated at final psi and B; zero outside plasma_mask.

outputs.name: plasma_currents
outputs.description: Terminal or step current density integrated with the explicitly declared node/cell-domain weights.
outputs.constraints: Default composite-trapezoid weights integrate exactly over the supplied node-domain rectangle; boundary nodes have half-interval weights. Explicit cell_edges=(radial_edges,axial_edges), each with center_count+1 monotone finite entries enclosing its centers, instead define cell-center areas. No 2*pi*R factor multiplies toroidal filament current.

outputs.name: picard_current_state
outputs.description: Last relaxed flattened cell-current feedback state.
outputs.constraints: At maxiter=0, the dependency's zero initial state is returned.

outputs.name: gradp_term
outputs.description: Terminal isotropic-comparison current contribution.
outputs.constraints: From unmasked terminal current decomposition; may be nonzero outside plasma_mask.

outputs.name: anisotropy_curvature_term
outputs.description: Terminal current remainder after isotropic comparison.
outputs.constraints: From unmasked current decomposition; may be nonzero outside plasma_mask.

outputs.name: converged
outputs.description: True when every unrelaxed state closes, parallel pressure force is compatible, and at least one iteration has executed.
outputs.constraints: fixed_point_residual<=tol and equilibrium_compatible and iterations>0; a small flux step caused by relaxation is not sufficient to prove convergence.

outputs.name: iterations
outputs.description: Number of performed feedback updates.
outputs.constraints: 0 <= iterations <= maxiter.

outputs.name: residual
outputs.description: Last relative flux-state change.
outputs.constraints: Initially infinity for maxiter=0; finite after a successful update.

outputs.name: residual_history
outputs.description: Relative flux change after each completed update.
outputs.constraints: Empty when maxiter=0; otherwise one value per update.

outputs.name: parameters
outputs.description: Shallow-copied input parameters with inserted B0 if absent.
outputs.constraints: Other caller keys are not normalized by the graph.

outputs.name: boundary_currents
outputs.description: Last ideal-conductor source-current coefficients.
outputs.constraints: None without a completed wall correction; from the last update if enabled.

outputs.name: boundary_flux_correction
outputs.description: Last wall response at field flux points.
outputs.constraints: None without a completed wall correction; its discrete flux derivatives are added to BR and BZ during that update.

outputs.name: boundary_residual_norm
outputs.description: Last sampled boundary-flux residual norm.
outputs.constraints: None without a completed wall correction; a nonzero value is allowed.

outputs.name: failure_reason
outputs.description: Explicit bounded nonconvergence marker.
outputs.constraints: parallel_force_incompatible when compatibility fails and strict_compatibility=false; otherwise None when an update executed and the full fixed point passes, or maxiter_reached when it does not pass or when the step count is zero.

outputs.name: fixed_point_residual
outputs.description: Full unrelaxed fixed-point residual of the returned state.
outputs.constraints: max(flux_fixed_point_residual,field_fixed_point_residual,current_fixed_point_residual); all candidates use the same plasma/wall projection, and convergence requires this value<=tol.

outputs.name: force_diagnostics
outputs.description: Full terminal force mapping.
outputs.constraints: Full terminal force mapping.

outputs.name: parallel_force_diagnostics
outputs.description: Compatibility reports the residual above a dimensioned 64-epsilon tensor/stencil rounding envelope, retaining raw absolute and relative residuals and the envelope. This is a floating-point resolution diagnostic, not a truncation-error bound or evidence that a sub-resolution physical force is exactly zero.
outputs.constraints: Compatibility reports the residual above a dimensioned 64-epsilon tensor/stencil rounding envelope, retaining raw absolute and relative residuals and the envelope. This is a floating-point resolution diagnostic, not a truncation-error bound or evidence that a sub-resolution physical force is exactly zero.

outputs.name: flux_converged
outputs.description: Whether the last relaxed flux step stagnated within tol.
outputs.constraints: Whether the last relaxed flux step stagnated within tol.

outputs.name: equilibrium_compatible
outputs.description: Whether the resolved parallel-force compatibility gate passes.
outputs.constraints: Whether the resolved parallel-force compatibility gate passes.

outputs.name: flux_fixed_point_residual
outputs.description: Unrelaxed target-to-current-state L2 difference for psi; denominator=max(||psi_target||,||psi_state||,||psi_vac||), and the residual is zero when all three are zero.
outputs.constraints: Nonnegative dimensionless diagnostic; binary floating-point scaling avoids norm overflow for finite states.

outputs.name: field_fixed_point_residual
outputs.description: Maximum of the relative L2 differences for BR and BZ; each component denominator=max(||B_target||,||B_state||,||B_vac||), and that component is zero when all three are zero.
outputs.constraints: Nonnegative dimensionless diagnostic; binary floating-point scaling avoids norm overflow for finite states.

outputs.name: current_fixed_point_residual
outputs.description: Unrelaxed target L2 difference between the current relaxed cell current and the returned-state pressure current; denominator=max(||I_target||,||I_state||), and the residual is zero when both are zero.
outputs.constraints: Nonnegative dimensionless diagnostic; binary floating-point scaling avoids norm overflow for finite states.

preconditions: The caller supplies a physically justified pressure closure and coherent vacuum/Green response on the exact same ordered grid.
The optional boundary matrices sample and correct the same flux basis; shape validation alone cannot prove physical consistency.
All bound dependencies accept the data encountered both during iteration and terminal reevaluation.
supported: Bounded anisotropic composition with declared-domain current quadrature, consistent flux/field corrections and terminal fixed-point/parallel-force diagnostics.
excluded: A built-in Frank-Egedal closure or independent validation of caller params and pressure physics.
Independent physical qualification of caller-supplied vacuum, Green or wall responses; consistent discrete wall-flux field increments alone do not establish a physical boundary model.
A general free-boundary equilibrium guarantee, automatic Green construction, or guaranteed Picard convergence.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for missing required ports, invalid grid, nonboolean/wrong-shaped mask, controls, params mapping, closure output or incomplete wall config; dependency validation errors propagate. The maintained implementation validates grid and mask before required ports, unlike the pending intake source. Non-mapping positional inputs are rejected by the composition layer with TypeError.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Pressure-closure callback and dependency errors propagate. Before every closure/current evaluation, B<minimum_field raises FloatingPointError; with strict_compatibility=true, terminal parallel-force incompatibility raises ValueError. The physical consistency of the Green and wall matrices must be independently justified by the caller.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: After at most maxiter updates, if the returned state's full fixed-point residual or force compatibility does not pass, return converged=false with an explicit failure reason. A final allowed update that happens to pass may still return converged=true. maxiter=0 skips updates and, after terminal evaluation, returns residual=inf with an empty history and does not claim convergence.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No mapping is returned after an exception. Bounded nonconvergence is a complete last-state mapping, not an exception.

example.description: A constant isotropic pressure and zero Green response complete one step without changing vacuum flux or field.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.equilibrium import solve_free_boundary_anisotropic_picard
r, z = np.meshgrid([0.2, 0.4, 0.6], [-0.1, 0.0, 0.1])
shape, size = r.shape, r.size
def closure(state):
    p = np.full(shape, 2.0)
    return {'p_parallel': p, 'p_perp': p, 'density': None, 'electron_temperature': None}
result = solve_free_boundary_anisotropic_picard(r_grid=r, z_grid=z, psi_vac=r**2/2, br_vac=np.zeros(shape), bz_vac=np.ones(shape), g_psi=np.zeros((size, size)), params={}, pressure_closure=closure, tol=1e-12, maxiter=1, relax=0.0)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['psi'], r**2/2)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['j_phi'], 0.0, atol=1e-12)
assert result['converged'] and result['iterations'] == 1 and result['failure_reason'] is None
example.expected: One converged update retains vacuum flux and zero toroidal current; no wall correction is applied.

scope: A manufactured polynomial wall response gives matching returned flux and magnetic field.
True parallel-pressure imbalance cannot be reported as equilibrium convergence.
Full retention relax=1 cannot turn a nonzero fixed-point residual into convergence.
An analytic rank-one Green feedback checks two-step state propagation and the terminal I^2+I-K=0 relation; relaxation that nearly preserves the old state must not exit early on a small step.
Do not claim convergence when flux stays fixed while field and current still change; a zero magnetic field fails closed before the pressure callback.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Manufactured and analytic discrete checks establish only the stated poloidal model and declared integration geometry. Arbitrary Green matrices, pressure closures, experimental plasma applicability and public release are not established by these tests.
known_limitations: Caller-supplied physical closures and Green responses require their own evidence and coherent psi=R A_phi (Wb/rad) normalization.
Floating-point rounding envelopes do not bound discretization error or experimental uncertainty.
No expert scientific endorsement or public release follows from this numerical successor.

nodes.description: Validate and pack geometry, retain configuration and initialize evolving vacuum psi/BR/BZ, current state and loop counters; initial B0 insertion and Picard-control validation follow the first field evaluation.
From the current BR/BZ compute the field magnitude and check minimum_field before every pressure/current evaluation; the initial state additionally computes the reference-field median.
Invoke caller pressure_closure({psi,B,params}) and validate the four declared profile values.
Compute full, isotropic-comparison and difference current terms on the current field/pressure state.
Clip current with the fixed mask, form and relax cell currents and project psi/BR/BZ through Green matrices.
When configured, solve the ideal-conductor linear boundary response for projected flux, then derive and add the field increment from that correction.
Select corrected flux and add the magnetic derivative of that same wall increment to the projected field.
Measure relative psi change after optional wall correction.

Stop when the full unrelaxed state residual<=tol after at least one iteration; otherwise continue to maxiter. The relaxed flux step is only appended as diagnostic history. A zero-step run keeps zero current and an infinite step residual.

At the returned psi/BR/BZ, recompute the field, deterministic pressure closure, current, nodal/cell weights and the full unrelaxed target; validate minimum_field and parallel-force compatibility; and output all state residuals, iterations and wall diagnostics. A zero-step run returns the initial zero current and does not claim convergence.
Use the current pressure/current to construct the unrelaxed Green target, apply the same wall flux and field increment, and independently report the psi/BR/BZ/current residuals and their maximum.

edges.description: The full unrelaxed fixed-point residual decides whether to stop or continue.

execution.ordering: Validate geometry and explicit ports, initialize the vacuum field and insert a default B0, then validate controls. Each iteration first checks minimum_field, then recomputes deterministic pressure and current on the current field and constructs the full unrelaxed Green/wall target; stop when at least one iteration has completed and the full residual passes, otherwise relax the current, update the Green field and wall flux/field, record the flux step, and continue to maxiter. At the terminal state recompute all pressure, current, fixed-point and force-compatibility diagnostics.
branches: Without a wall, use projected flux and its field response.
With a wall, use projected flux plus wall correction and the derivative-consistent magnetic increment.
maxiter=0 evaluates terminal diagnostics but does not claim convergence.
Incompatible parallel force raises by default; strict_compatibility=false returns converged=false and explicit diagnostics.
execution.state_ownership: The graph owns evolving psi/BR/BZ, prior relaxed cell currents, residual and history; the caller owns vacuum state, Green matrices, fixed mask, parameter mapping and pressure_closure.
execution.failure_propagation: Invalid inputs, closure outputs and dependency failures abort without partial mapping. Only bounded nonconvergence yields a last-state mapping with failure_reason.

feedback.state: psi, BR, BZ, prior relaxed cell currents, residual history and update count
feedback.initialization: psi/BR/BZ start from vacuum inputs, prior currents are None, residual is infinity, history empty and count zero.
feedback.update_order: current-field floor check -> deterministic pressure -> current -> full unrelaxed target stopping test -> relaxed current -> Green flux/field -> wall flux and derivative field -> diagnostic history -> next state.
feedback.continue_when: Full unrelaxed state residual>tol and executed updates<maxiter; the initial state must execute one iteration first.
feedback.stop_when: After at least one iteration, the full unrelaxed state residual<=tol, or the update count reaches maxiter (including the zero-step bound).
feedback.nonconvergence: Return final reevaluated state with converged=false and failure_reason='maxiter_reached'; no hidden retry.
